decisions.command:
python3 -c "
import json
from producer import encode
from consumer import decode

raw = encode('r-7', {'kind': 'ping'})
print('encoded:', raw)
print('parsed:', json.loads(raw))

rid, body = decode(raw)
print('decoded id:', rid)
print('decoded body:', body)
assert rid == 'r-7', 'request id not stable'

# missing version rejection
import sys
missing = json.dumps({'request': {'id': 'r-7', 'body': {'kind': 'ping'}}})
try:
    decode(missing)
    print('FAIL: no ValueError raised')
    sys.exit(1)
except ValueError as e:
    print('rejected missing version with ValueError:', e)
"
